description: Let \(R\) be an irreflexive transitive relation and let \(a,b\) be distinct incomparable points. Define \(\widehat R(x,y)\) by \(R(x,y)\lor((x=a\lor R(x,a))\land(b=y\lor R(b,y)))\). Then \(\widehat R\) is irreflexive and transitive, extends \(R\), and relates \(a\) to \(b\).
